hypothesis: A real Deribit options vol-surface/greeks term-structure calendar spread (long near-expiry ATM straddle / short far-expiry ATM straddle at a common strike, delta-hedged in the perpetual) is net-of-cost tradable for the underlying BTC/ETH perpetual on real, synchronized Deribit data.

protocol.title: Real Deribit options vol-surface / greeks term-structure calendar-spread net-of-cost falsification
protocol.surface_to_greeks: per real 5m snapshot & near/far expiry pair at a common strike nearest spot: IV backed out of each real mark (implied_volatility(mark*spot, spot, K, 0, T, type)); delta/gamma from black_scholes_greeks at that IV
protocol.cost_model: net-of-cost: hedge turnover HEDGE_FEE_BPS on |Δhedge|*S; each of the 4 calendar legs pays half its real bid/ask at entry and half at exit
protocol.option_spread: each of the 4 calendar legs pays half its real bid/ask at entry and half at exit (long and short legs both charged the round-trip spread)
protocol.pnl: dOption_k = (near_price_{k+1} - near_price_k) - (far_price_{k+1} - far_price_k); gross_k = dOption_k + hedge_k*dS_k (hedge = -net_position_delta); ret_k = (gross_k - cost_k)/S_k; decision at bar k -> outcome over [k,k+1] (causal)
protocol.common_strike_rule: nearest-to-spot strike quoted call+put in BOTH near & far expiry; fallback nearest common strike across the two; else config invalid
protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on both BTC and ETH and at least one grid config, net-of-cost Sharpe > 0, no kill-switch breach (max-DD <= 0.20), permutation p < 0.05, bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, and pooled PBO < 0.5; else NO-GO.
